# Desktop Autogenerated State

## Audit Target

Test desktop behavior with generated or demo-like populated data.

## Inspect

- Generated SKUs/services, observations, demand, sales, orders, receipts, charts, tables, projections, and inventory health metrics.

## Real Finding Criteria

Generated data reveals layout overflow, broken formatting, bad calculations, chart instability, broken filters, or inconsistent detail views.

## Fix Constraints

Keep fixtures deterministic and avoid masking bugs by weakening generated coverage.

## Verification Required

Run generated-state UI tests or screenshots. Record fixture size and surfaces checked in the item notes.
